title: Digging Deeper: Conversations in Fundamental Investing
description: A panel discussion at Sohn 2026 featuring a group of experienced investors— Andrew Bellas, Eduardo Marques, David Rosen, and Jonathan Lennon —moderated by Mitch Golden. The conversation focuses on investment strategies within the current market environment, including the impacts of AI and the persistence of value investing.
summary: The video argues that several semiconductor and technology stocks offer significant value, citing Micron and SK Hynix as massive cash generators trading at low multiples. It suggests that SK Square provides a discounted entry point to SK Hynix, while Samsung Life and Samsung Electronics are highlighted as undervalued holdings within the broader Samsung ecosystem. Additionally, the pitch identifies Reddit, Viatris, and Carvana as high-upside opportunities driven by AI potential, drug pipeline rescheduling, and strong growth projections, respectively.
